content.scenario: The Central Council meets to discuss the promotion and protection of consumer rights. A consumer in Chennai wants to know the objects of the Central Council.
content.outcome: The Central Council renders advice on the promotion and protection of consumer rights under the Act, and its objects are to advise on these matters.

user_queries: What are the objects of the Central Council?
How does the Central Council promote consumer rights?
What is the role of the Central Council in advising on consumer protection?
